23:15 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: College Football
The Arizona State Sun Devils (6-4) host the Oklahoma State Cowboys (6-4) at Mountain America Stadium in a Big 12 matchup. The teams enter this game with identical records. Arizona State aims for a three-game win streak after a 26-13 win against UCF.
